tbesh_html:
1) to put to shame, be ashamed, be disconcerted, be disappointed
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to feel shame
1a2) to be ashamed, disconcerted, disappointed (by reason of)
1b) (Piel) to delay (in shame)
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to put to shame
1c2) to act shamefully
1c3) to be ashamed
1d) (Hithpolel) to be ashamed before one another

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.

occurrences.bsb: And the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
occurrences.kjv: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, “Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!”
occurrences.kjv: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

occurrences.bsb: So they waited until they became worried and saw that he had still not opened the doors of the upper room. Then they took the key and opened the doors—and there was their lord lying dead on the floor.
occurrences.kjv: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

occurrences.bsb: Sisera’s mother looked through the window; she peered through the lattice and lamented: ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? What has delayed the clatter of his chariots?’
occurrences.kjv: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

occurrences.bsb: Then Joab went into the house and said to the king, “Today you have disgraced all your servants who have saved your life and the lives of your sons and daughters, of your wives, and of your concubines.
occurrences.kjv: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

occurrences.bsb: But when they pressed him to the point of embarrassment, he said, “Send them.” And they sent fifty men, who searched for three days but did not find Elijah.
occurrences.kjv: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

occurrences.bsb: Elisha fixed his gaze steadily on him until Hazael became uncomfortable. Then the man of God began to weep.
occurrences.kjv: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore their inhabitants, devoid of power, are dismayed and ashamed. They are like plants in the field, tender green shoots, grass on the rooftops, scorched before it is grown.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

occurrences.bsb: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road, since we had told him, “The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.”
occurrences.kjv: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.

occurrences.bsb: and said: “O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.
occurrences.kjv: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.

occurrences.bsb: They are confounded because they had hoped; their arrival brings disappointment.
occurrences.kjv: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: Ten times now you have reproached me; you shamelessly mistreat me.
occurrences.kjv: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

occurrences.bsb: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
occurrences.kjv: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

occurrences.bsb: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.
occurrences.kjv: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.

occurrences.bsb: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
occurrences.kjv: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

occurrences.bsb: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
occurrences.kjv: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

occurrences.bsb: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

occurrences.bsb: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
occurrences.kjv: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

occurrences.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
occurrences.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

occurrences.bsb: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
occurrences.kjv: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

occurrences.bsb: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

occurrences.bsb: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

occurrences.bsb: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
occurrences.kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

occurrences.bsb: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

occurrences.bsb: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
occurrences.kjv: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

occurrences.bsb: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.
occurrences.kjv: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

occurrences.bsb: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

occurrences.bsb: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

occurrences.bsb: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

occurrences.bsb: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
occurrences.kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

occurrences.bsb: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

occurrences.bsb: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
occurrences.kjv: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

occurrences.bsb: All worshipers of images are put to shame—those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
occurrences.kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

occurrences.bsb: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
occurrences.kjv: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

occurrences.bsb: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
occurrences.kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

occurrences.bsb: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

occurrences.bsb: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
occurrences.kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
occurrences.kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

occurrences.bsb: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
occurrences.kjv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
occurrences.kjv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

occurrences.bsb: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
occurrences.kjv: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

occurrences.bsb: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
occurrences.kjv: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

occurrences.bsb: A wife of noble character is her husband’s crown, but she who causes shame is like decay in his bones.
occurrences.kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

occurrences.bsb: A king delights in a wise servant, but his anger falls on the shameful.
occurrences.kjv: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

occurrences.bsb: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share his inheritance as one of the brothers.
occurrences.kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

occurrences.bsb: He who assaults his father or evicts his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.
occurrences.kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

occurrences.bsb: A rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.
occurrences.kjv: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.

occurrences.bsb: Surely you will be ashamed of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted; you will be embarrassed by the gardens that you have chosen.
occurrences.kjv: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

occurrences.bsb: The workers in flax will be dismayed, and the weavers of fine linen will turn pale.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.

occurrences.bsb: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.
occurrences.kjv: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

occurrences.bsb: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth. I have not raised young men or brought up young women.”
occurrences.kjv: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.

occurrences.bsb: The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders with great glory.
occurrences.kjv: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.

occurrences.bsb: O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!
occurrences.kjv: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore the LORD who redeemed Abraham says of the house of Jacob: “No longer will Jacob be ashamed and no more will his face grow pale.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

occurrences.bsb: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them. They bring neither help nor benefit, but only shame and disgrace.”
occurrences.kjv: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore their inhabitants, devoid of power, are dismayed and ashamed. They are like plants in the field, tender green shoots, grass on the rooftops, scorched before it is grown.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

occurrences.bsb: Behold, all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced; those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.

occurrences.bsb: But those who trust in idols and say to molten images, ‘You are our gods!’ will be turned back in utter shame.
occurrences.kjv: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.

occurrences.bsb: All makers of idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Their witnesses fail to see or comprehend, so they are put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: Behold, all his companions will be put to shame, for the craftsmen themselves are only human. Let them all assemble and take their stand; they will all be brought to terror and shame.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.

occurrences.bsb: They will all be put to shame and humiliated; the makers of idols will depart together in disgrace.
occurrences.kjv: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.

occurrences.bsb: But Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; you will not be put to shame or humiliated, to ages everlasting.
occurrences.kjv: But Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

occurrences.bsb: Surely they will say of Me, ‘In the LORD alone are righteousness and strength.’” All who rage against Him will come to Him and be put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: Surely, shall one say, in the Lord have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow to you facedown and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in Me will never be put to shame.”
occurrences.kjv: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

occurrences.bsb: Because the Lord GOD helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: For the Lord God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; do not be intimidated, for you will not be humiliated. For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
occurrences.kjv: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

occurrences.bsb: You who tremble at His word, hear the word of the LORD: “Your brothers who hate you and exclude you because of My name have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified that we may see your joy!’ But they will be put to shame.”
occurrences.kjv: Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: As the thief is ashamed when he is caught, so the house of Israel is disgraced. They, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets
occurrences.kjv: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,

occurrences.bsb: How impulsive you are, constantly changing your ways! You will be disappointed by Egypt just as you were by Assyria.
occurrences.kjv: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

occurrences.bsb: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse,” says the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the LORD, what wisdom do they really have?
occurrences.kjv: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the Lord; and what wisdom is in them?

occurrences.bsb: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse, says the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For the sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How devastated we are! How great is our shame! For we have abandoned the land because our dwellings have been torn down.’”
occurrences.kjv: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.

occurrences.bsb: They have sown wheat but harvested thorns. They have exhausted themselves to no avail. Bear the shame of your harvest because of the fierce anger of the LORD.”
occurrences.kjv: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns, but find no water; their jars return empty. They are ashamed and humiliated; they cover their heads.
occurrences.kjv: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

occurrences.bsb: The ground is cracked because no rain has fallen on the land. The farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads.
occurrences.kjv: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

occurrences.bsb: The mother of seven will grow faint; she will breathe her last breath. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. And the rest I will put to the sword in the presence of their enemies,” declares the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who abandon You will be put to shame. All who turn away will be written in the dust, for they have abandoned the LORD, the fountain of living water.
occurrences.kjv: O Lord, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the Lord, the fountain of living waters.

occurrences.bsb: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but do not let me be put to shame. Let them be terrified, but do not let me be terrified. Bring upon them the day of disaster and shatter them with double destruction.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

occurrences.bsb: But the LORD is with me like a fearsome warrior. Therefore, my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail. Since they have not succeeded, they will be utterly put to shame, with an everlasting disgrace that will never be forgotten.
occurrences.kjv: But the Lord is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

occurrences.bsb: The wind will drive away all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Then you will be ashamed and humiliated because of all your wickedness.
occurrences.kjv: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

occurrences.bsb: After I returned, I repented; and after I was instructed, I struck my thigh in grief. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’
occurrences.kjv: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

occurrences.bsb: The Daughter of Egypt will be put to shame; she will be delivered into the hands of the people of the north.”
occurrences.kjv: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

occurrences.bsb: Concerning Moab, this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo, for it will be devastated. Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced; the fortress will be shattered and dismantled.
occurrences.kjv: Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.

occurrences.bsb: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel.
occurrences.kjv: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence.

occurrences.bsb: Moab is put to shame, for it has been shattered. Wail and cry out! Declare by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.
occurrences.kjv: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,

occurrences.bsb: “How shattered it is! How they wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule and horror to all those around him.”
occurrences.kjv: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.

occurrences.bsb: Concerning Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard a bad report; they are agitated like the sea; their anxiety cannot be calmed.
occurrences.kjv: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

occurrences.bsb: “Announce and declare to the nations; lift up a banner and proclaim it; hold nothing back when you say, ‘Babylon is captured; Bel is put to shame; Marduk is shattered, her images are disgraced, her idols are broken in pieces.’
occurrences.kjv: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

occurrences.bsb: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who bore you will be disgraced. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
occurrences.kjv: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

occurrences.bsb: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
occurrences.kjv: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, behold, the days are coming when I will punish the idols of Babylon. Her entire land will suffer shame, and all her slain will lie fallen within her.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

occurrences.bsb: “We are ashamed because we have heard reproach; disgrace has covered our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the LORD’s house.”
occurrences.kjv: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the Lord’s house.

occurrences.bsb: So now you must bear your disgrace, since you have brought justification for your sisters. For they appear more righteous than you, because your sins were more vile than theirs. So you too must bear your shame and disgrace, since you have made your sisters appear righteous.
occurrences.kjv: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

occurrences.bsb: so that when I make atonement for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your disgrace, declares the Lord GOD.”
occurrences.kjv: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord God.

occurrences.bsb: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit.
occurrences.kjv: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

occurrences.bsb: It is not for your sake that I will act, declares the Lord GOD—let it be known to you. Be ashamed and disgraced for your ways, O house of Israel!
occurrences.kjv: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord God, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace. For she thought, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.’
occurrences.kjv: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.

occurrences.bsb: The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
occurrences.kjv: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

occurrences.bsb: Yes, it will be carried to Assyria as tribute to the great king. Ephraim will be seized with shame; Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols.
occurrences.kjv: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

occurrences.bsb: Be dismayed, O farmers, wail, O vinedressers, over the wheat and barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.
occurrences.kjv: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.

occurrences.bsb: The grapevine is dried up, and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, palm, and apple—all the trees of the orchard—are withered. Surely the joy of mankind has dried up.
occurrences.kjv: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.

occurrences.bsb: You will have plenty to eat, until you are satisfied. You will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you. My people will never again be put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God, and there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced. They will all cover their mouths because there is no answer from God.”
occurrences.kjv: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.

occurrences.bsb: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.
occurrences.kjv: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

occurrences.bsb: On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.
occurrences.kjv: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.

occurrences.bsb: Ashkelon will see and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, as will Ekron, for her hope will wither. There will cease to be a king in Gaza, and Ashkelon will be uninhabited.
occurrences.kjv: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

occurrences.bsb: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.
occurrences.kjv: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the Lord is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.

occurrences.bsb: And on that day every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision, and he will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
